repository.name: @webex/calling
repository.purpose: TypeScript SDK package for Webex Calling clients, registration, call control and media, call history and recordings, settings, contacts, voicemail, telemetry, and Mobius WebSocket transport.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/calling package exports
entrypoints: import {createClient, createCallHistoryClient, createCallSettingsClient, createContactsClient, createVoicemailClient, createCallRecordingClient, createMicrophoneStream, Logger, NoiseReductionEffect} from '@webex/calling'
public_interfaces.audience: Web applications and Webex SDK consumers that add Webex Calling
public_interfaces.notes: src/index.ts also re-exports the event key enums, error classes, call, line, settings, history, recording, contacts, and voicemail types. Built to dist/module/index.js with declarations in dist/types/index.d.ts. TypeDoc reads src/api.ts.

public_interfaces.name: Calling client
public_interfaces.audience: Applications that place and receive Webex Calling calls
public_interfaces.notes: createClient is async and resolves an ICallingClient. Behavior is specified in src/CallingClient/docs/README.md and its line, calling, and registration child specs.

public_interfaces.name: Feature clients
public_interfaces.audience: Applications that read call history, recordings, settings, contacts, or voicemail
public_interfaces.notes: Each factory returns a client for the resolved calling backend (Webex Calling, UCM, or BroadWorks). Behavior is specified in each module's docs/README.md.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: Run from packages/calling; yarn workspace @webex/calling plus the script name is equivalent from the workspace root.

refresh_with: update alongside the behavior change in the same commit

generated_artifacts.refresh_with: Run the setup script of the active Repo Annotation installation against the monorepo root

recommended: run with approved test accounts only

change_impact.notes: Removing or renaming an export is a breaking change for consumers.

affects: call and ROAP state machines and media
change_impact.notes: State-machine and timer changes need unit tests with fake timers; see the registration and calling module specs.

affects: every module's access to the Webex SDK

glossary.definition: Top-level calling orchestration client that creates lines and coordinates registration/call lifecycle
glossary.notes: Not the same as an individual Call. src/CallingClient/

glossary.definition: A telephony line exposed to consumers for registration and call operations
One inbound/outbound call lifecycle and its signaling/media state
Mobius device registration, keepalive, failover/failback, and cleanup lifecycle
Webex Calling signaling/backend service reached over HTTP or WebSocket
Webex real-time event channel used for session/recording events
glossary.notes: The host Webex SDK owns the connection. src/SDKConnector/ and src/Events/types.ts
Remote service, not local storage. src/CallHistory/

glossary.definition: WebRTC offer/answer protocol used by the media engine
Resolved WXC, UCM, or BroadWorks behavior/provider
glossary.notes: Capability matrices differ. src/common/types.ts and src/common/Utils.ts

glossary.definition: Singleton adapter around the host Webex SDK

evidence_rules.requirement: The script must exist in package.json scripts.
evidence_rules.notes: Workspace-root commands (yarn, yarn prebuild:modules) come from the root CONTRIBUTING.md and the deploy workflow.

evidence_rules.requirement: Only names exported by src/index.ts are public imports.
evidence_rules.notes: src/api.ts is the TypeDoc entry and must stay aligned with src/index.ts.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or co-located test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not an evidence source for this package.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log tokens, credentials, or personal data.
negative_guidance.why: Log lines reach the host console and support logs; see the package architecture security sections.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not lower or bypass the jest.config.js coverage thresholds.
negative_guidance.why: test:unit enforces them locally and in the pull-request workflow.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not recreate ai-docs folders or documentation outside the manifest-routed paths.
negative_guidance.why: docs/adr/0001-migrate-ai-docs-to-repo-standards.md retired them so each fact has one canonical home.

high.expectation: Source and co-located unit tests both support the change.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question, for example remote Mobius or Janus server behavior. Stop and report the gap.

main_entrypoints.name: package entry
main_entrypoints.purpose: Value and type exports of the SDK

main_entrypoints.name: TypeDoc entry
main_entrypoints.notes: Read by yarn docs and yarn build:docs.

workspace_packages.name: @webex/calling
workspace_packages.notes: 13 modules; this SDD root is the package directory packages/calling inside the webex-js-sdk monorepo.

source_surfaces.name: shared package code
source_surfaces.notes: No module spec; described in docs/architecture.md.

generated_surfaces.name: build output
generated_surfaces.notes: Produced by tsc. Do not edit by hand.

sync_paths.mechanism: Setup script of the active Repo Annotation installation
sync_paths.notes: The package holds no templates. It refers to the monorepo root snapshot at ../../.sdd/templates/repo-standards through layout.monorepo_package.templates_root_path in .sdd/manifest.json.

validation_entrypoints.name: unit tests
validation_entrypoints.notes: Jest over co-located src/**/*.test.ts with the jest.config.js coverage thresholds.

validation_entrypoints.name: lint
validation_entrypoints.notes: eslint over src/**/*.ts with the workspace root .eslintrc.js.

surface_owners.edit_boundary: The monorepo .github/CODEOWNERS has no entry for packages/calling, so the default * rule applies.

fallback_rules: When source and tests disagree, code is the referee and the disagreement is recorded rather than silently resolved.
When neither source nor tests settle a question, report it as a gap instead of inferring.
Commit history is not a valid rationale source for this package.
